Marketing Starts With The Customer , Not The Product!

Learn the fundamentals of marketing from scratch by understanding the four questions behind every successful marketing strategy:

  • • WHO — Customers: Who are you trying to reach and serve?
  • • WHAT — Product/Service: What are you offering to solve their problem or fulfil their desire?
  • • HOW — Channel: How will you reach, communicate with, and convert them?
  • • WHY — Purpose/Reason: Why should they care, buy, stay, return, or choose you?

This course will teach you how to understand the market, identify your audience, discover demand, test ideas, understand customer behaviour, and connect the right offer to the right people.
